svg.metadata: Revalis retrofit module M02; model-derived HLR and solid sections; geometry mm; A3 landscape; Service and calibration access
svg.text: Nominal and removed views use the same source solids; no service or isolation procedure is certified.
Nonmetallic carrier and handle with an unselected coupon envelope. Illustrative carrier: 100 x 140
mm. Material, target response, repeatability and safe insertion remain unresolved.

Isolate the line, release access hardware, disconnect and support the cartridge, then withdraw toward -Y. Coordinate the service aisle with the existing line and route all removable leads for disconnection.
An empty translation envelope is not a safe servicing method.
Reserve a repeatable target insertion path along -X, 450 mm proposed. Define
traceable references for pose, conductivity, geometry, temperature and frequency
Proposed lid removal: +200 mm Z. Allow lens cleaning and camera adjustment, then
restore calibration and enclosure integrity. No optical device rating or ingress
Front panel withdrawal: 350 mm toward -Y. Maintain cable slack, connector access
and a protected work area. Power isolation, interlocks and protective bonding
Exact CAD solids are shown at nominal and proposed service offsets. Read the
separate verification report for the swept-interference check and exclusions. Cable
reach, hand/tool access and safe servicing remain unvalidated.
Real tools, hands, lift/support devices, connector pull lengths, sag, wear and
operator access are not validated. Component selection and maintainability trials
DIMENSIONS: mm | SCALE PER VIEW AT A3 | PROPOSED RESEARCH GEOMETRY
No approved fit, tolerance, load, electromagnetic coverage, throughput or safeguarding rating.
